title: All you need: Performance
description: a lightweight Minecraft optimization pack that boosts FPS, reduces lag, and improves loading times while keeping the vanilla experience intact. Regularly updated for the latest Minecraft versions.
body:
**All You Need Performance** is a modern optimization modpack focused on delivering the **best possible Minecraft performance** while preserving the vanilla experience. Every included mod has been selected to improve FPS, reduce lag spikes, decrease memory usage, and shorten loading times—without adding unnecessary features or changing gameplay.

Whether you're playing on a low-end laptop or a high-end gaming PC, this pack provides a smoother and more responsive experience. It's lightweight, regularly updated for the latest Minecraft releases, and designed to work seamlessly with multiplayer servers, shaders (where supported), and resource packs.

**Features:**

-  Higher FPS and smoother gameplay
- Faster loading time
-  Reduced RAM usage
-  Vanilla-friendly experience
